posts.author: bsetianto
posts.content_md:
We are currently facing challenges in obtaining the Negative Plates required for our H1 hologram production. We typically use Geola VRP-M plates, but we have recently experienced significant difficulties in obtaining them.

Due to these supply issues, we urgently need a suitable alternative.

We are looking for Negative Plates for the H1 that have similar specifications and performance characteristics to Geola VRP-M. We use a 442nm laser.

Thank you for your time and assistance.

posts.author: lobaz
posts.content_md: Sadly, there are not many options. As far as I know, the only remaining "large" AgX producers are Ultimate Holography ([https://shop.ultimate-holography.com](https://shop.ultimate-holography.com)) and TruLifeOptics ([https://trulifeoptics.com/holographic-materials/](https://trulifeoptics.com/holographic-materials/), formerly ColourHolographics). Especially Ultimate is worth asking, as Yves Gentet is quite flexible in using various sensitising dyes.
